_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 49: 24-28 February 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He asks what the Holy Spirit said about it in February, says they went over it again in February of this year, is corrected that it was last year, and accepts the correction.
mentions.quote: Not this year. This last year
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, but worth recording: he misdates his own word by a year and is corrected on air.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says they went from believing to being fully persuaded that what God promised he is able to perform, that he is fully persuaded God is his provider, and answers the objection that the bank account says otherwise.
mentions.quote: I'm fully persuaded that my God is my provider
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it explicitly rules the bank balance out as evidence.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the bombardment was so heavy that the air defence systems, like the dome back in July, could not keep up with everything happening and some of them were getting through.
mentions.quote: even Israel couldn't keep up with all of what was happening
mentions.falsify_match: Israeli air defences overwhelmed by mass missile fire.
mentions.falsify_miss: They hold. He is describing something already seen rather than forecasting a date.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a man crossing to the White House with his tongue licking the ground concerning 2028, tasting the dirt, trying to go, says remember Booker, and that he saw these two people and they do not have a replacement.
mentions.quote: with his tongue licking the ground concerning 2028, tasting the dirt
mentions.falsify_match: A named Democratic figure running in 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not run. The image is an appetite for the office rather than a prediction of success.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw that man in the spirit and has been praying for him, that he will be polished, and names Marco Rubio, then addresses people asking who the lizard is, says he did not say reptilian and is not trying to say that, and that the Lord said chameleon.
mentions.quote: I didn't say he was reptilian. The Lord said he's chameleon
mentions.falsify_match: A named figure visibly changing position.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is correcting his audience's reading of his own image, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2028 will be the year of a Watergate if they do not pray, repeats it, calls it a new Watergate like Nixon, says the Lord said to pray about this because it will be about X and things like that.
mentions.quote: 2028 will be a year of a Watergate if we do not pray
mentions.falsify_match: A major political scandal in 2028 centred on the platform.
mentions.falsify_miss: None, and the prayer clause absorbs the absence.

mentions.claim_text: They discuss emojis and he says he will do prayer again tomorrow night closing out the month and they will see where they are with it if he pushes the button tonight into tomorrow.
mentions.quote: I'll do prayer again tomorrow night with y'all closing out this month
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: scheduling.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that will be going into when the inauguration will be just barely there, probably the 21st of January, and it will be inauguration time, and they note it is New Year's Eve and the start of the new year.
mentions.quote: the 21st probably of January and it'll be inauguration time
mentions.falsify_match: An inauguration on 21 January.
mentions.falsify_miss: Presidential inaugurations are fixed to 20 January, so the date he gives is one day out.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether he said anything about March 3rd, tells them to study that about March 3rd, and asks whether the Lord has said anything about March 3rd.
mentions.quote: Have I said anything? Has the Lord said anything about March 3rd?
mentions.falsify_match: A March 3rd word in the record.
mentions.falsify_miss: There is none, and he is asking his own team to check rather than recalling it.

mentions.claim_text: He is answered that it was all about February 3rd, and says that is because he said three three, trace trace, and that he saw trace about the third.
mentions.quote: it was all about February 3rd cuz I said three three trace trace
mentions.falsify_match: The record shows February 3rd, which it does across seven tellings.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a. Recorded because the date has now passed with the content never specified, and he is looking for a March version of it.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the DEA will find them, and that other departments that are not corrupt would squeal on these small towns.
mentions.quote: the DEA will find them
mentions.falsify_match: Drug enforcement actions in small towns.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No town is named.

mentions.claim_text: He points to the ark behind him, says that as in the days of Noah so will it be when the Son of Man returns, that the ark door is closing soon, that this dispensation of grace is coming to an end and the tribulation is about to begin.
mentions.quote: the ark door is closing soon
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: soon with no date, said continuously since the channel began.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays they are in the right place at the right time doing exactly what they are called to do, repeats that a thousand shall fall at their side and ten thousand at their right hand but nothing shall come near them, and thanks God that President Trump is protected.
mentions.quote: I thank you, Lord, for President Trump, that he is protected
mentions.falsify_match: He survives, credited to the prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: Structurally unfalsifiable, as recorded in November.

mentions.claim_text: They discuss having to check the NASA website to see where it will be visible, mention the poles, and land on March 26 and where the totality ends.
mentions.quote: March 26. Where it shows where it will be seen
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: they are reading a published eclipse path off a website, not receiving a date.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says this next week will be fun, mentions a blood moon and the planets aligning, says he wants to watch it and wonders how they can see it, and that they will be out there watching.
mentions.quote: this next week. Blood Moon. The planets align
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a scheduled and published astronomical event, treated here as something to enjoy rather than as a sign.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He jokes about someone taking a clipboard and leaving over a mental issue, says he caused one of the sheep to stumble while trying to be fun because there are all kinds of sensitive people out there, then says let us be serious.
mentions.quote: I caused one of the sheep to stumble
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: banter and a half apology for it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He introduces what the Lord showed him on January the 12th of 2026 and plays it: that major disruptions are about to erupt in Pakistan, repeated, and that he saw Pakistan very clearly.
mentions.quote: Major disruptions are about to erupt in Pakistan
mentions.falsify_match: Major unrest or political rupture in Pakistan after 12 January 2026. The original telling is inside this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such disruption. Disruptions is not defined as political, military or economic.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know if she is a citizen or not, mentions her corruption with the winery and the things they were saying, asks them to play it, and notes that was December the 11th when he gave the word about the bees coming up out of the ground.
mentions.quote: even with her corruption with the winery
mentions.falsify_match: A named woman with a winery facing corruption findings.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The winery is a real new detail after five tellings, and it narrows who is meant.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions the squad, says he sees her face before him, that it concerns corruption, that people are fed up and want to replace her, that it is time for her to go, and repeats that he sees corruption.
mentions.quote: people are fed up with this to replace her. It's time for her to go
mentions.falsify_match: The woman losing her seat or office.
mentions.falsify_miss: She keeps it. The squad reference narrows the field considerably, though he still does not name her.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they know when you start a hive and the bees circle you trying to sting and you run, and says these bees are coming up out of the land where there are beautiful flowers and green, circling.
mentions.quote: These bees are coming up out of the land
mentions.falsify_match: See the removal claim it belongs to.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: They work out that it was back in November and September when they found all that secret communication, and he says the Lord said there is some in Chicago and some elsewhere.
mentions.quote: the Lord said there's some in Chicago
mentions.falsify_match: A SIM farm found in Chicago.
mentions.falsify_miss: None found. Second telling of the Chicago detail, unchanged.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the man would have a greater relationship with God than ever before and would be a great leader to the nation as vice president, and thanks God for the leaders of the nation, the Senate and the House.
mentions.quote: that he would be a great leader to our nation as vice president
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer for character, not an outcome.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that is theirs, the chariots of fire on December the 25th of 2024, when God spoke to him and said I am giving out the gifts, and he saw those chariots of fire going throughout the world dropping them on people.
mentions.quote: the chariots of fire on December the 25th of 2024
mentions.falsify_match: Reported spiritual gifts appearing among listeners.
mentions.falsify_miss: None reported. The original telling is inside this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him not to focus on it, that when the anointing comes on him he is learning that not everything he sees is what he is supposed to talk about, that he has to get faster at discerning what the Lord wants him to say, and that it is a river.
mentions.quote: not everything that I see anymore that I'm supposed to talk about
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the withholding rule stated again: an unpublished sight cannot be scored.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He recommends a book, says he did not know the man could write as well as he does, calls it another life-changing book, notes it is one of the first books the author ever wrote, and asks how they have never read it.
mentions.quote: it's another life-changing book
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a reading recommendation, useful for placing the tradition he teaches from.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that at an adult level it is like school, where you are often not invited and may be a little different because you had special needs or whatever it is.
mentions.quote: you may be a little different because you had special needs
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: about exclusion of adults with special needs, and about his own household.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to go by what he said and post it because he wants them to hear it, and introduces the raw recording from February 1 of what the Lord showed him about the anonymous man.
mentions.quote: This is February 1 of what the Lord showed me about this anonymous man
mentions.falsify_match: He plays the raw original rather than paraphrasing it, which is the third such on-air check in six weeks.
mentions.falsify_miss: The recording does not say it.

mentions.claim_text: He says he wants them to hear the rest of it, that he believes this is the beginning stages of it coming out, that there will be more things exposed than people realised, and that this is about to get really ugly.
mentions.quote: there'll be more things exposed than what people realized
mentions.falsify_match: A widening scandal involving the man in question.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is anonymous, so nothing can be matched to him.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw that they lose the Senate and it flips blue, and that the Lord said if they do not pray as they all did for President Trump to win last November, then it happens.
mentions.quote: I saw that we lose the Senate and it flips blue
mentions.falsify_match: Democrats take the Senate in November 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Republicans hold it. Fourth consistent telling of the same call, now with the prayer clause attached so a hold also confirms it.
